summary: Role transition: staggered permission handoff and laptop reassignment for IC->Manager
description:
Issue summary:
A senior individual contributor (IC) is being promoted to an engineering manager. We need a staged access transition that preserves ongoing project access for 7 days while enabling manager-level privileges for a subset of systems immediately. The request includes reassignment of the existing work laptop to the manager role owner pool after an inspection and re-image window, and coordinated handoff of 2 service accounts used by the engineer's automation scripts.

Impact:
- If access is removed too early, backlog PRs and on-call rotations could be disrupted.
- If elevated privileges are granted without revoking certain IC-level service accounts, there is risk of permissions creep.

Background/context:
- Employee: Rahul Mehta (engineering)
- Current state: IC, has multiple service accounts (svc-ci-deploy, svc-data-sync) and a company MacBook Pro (asset tag RW-AP-9932).
- Promotion effective date: 2026-03-15. HR has requested access changes to start on that date.

Requested outcome:
1) Grant manager-level group membership in Okta and add to manager-specific Slack and LDAP groups on 2026-03-15 morning (09:00 PT).
2) Keep project-level repo write access and CI deploy rights for 7 calendar days (until 2026-03-22 23:59 PT) to finish in-flight work.
3) Transfer ownership of automation service accounts to the new manager (Rahul) after a credential rotation and audit; svc-* accounts must be rotated and access logged before final transfer.
4) Schedule laptop handback inspection and re-image to corporate baseline after 14 calendar days from promotion (window 2026-03-29 to 2026-04-02), then return asset to manager device pool.
5) Document the sequence in Confluence runbook and notify Payroll/Facilities of scheduled pickup date.

Constraints/policy questions (see 'policy_clarification' below):
- Current internal policy allows up to 72 hours of overlap for role changes; business requests for longer overlaps require approval. Requesting explicit exception for 7 days.

Attachments: asset manifest export, HR promotion email (redacted), list of service accounts and recent last-used timestamps.
steps_to_reproduce: N/A - HR transition workflow request. Steps below detail coordination tasks rather than reproducible bug steps.
investigation_notes:
1) Confirmed asset RW-AP-9932 serial matches inventory (AssetDB entry exists, last checked 2026-02-10).
2) Checked Okta group schema: manager-group grants access to /admin-console and payroll reporting service; these are compatible with requested elevation.
3) svc-ci-deploy and svc-data-sync are currently bound to Rahul's personal SSH key via vault token; tokens need rotation. Last rotation timestamps: svc-ci-deploy 2025-12-02, svc-data-sync 2026-01-08.
4) SCIM sync runs nightly at 02:30 UTC; immediate group changes must account for propagation lag across systems (estimate 5-15 minutes post-sync).
5) Need sign-off from Security for credential rotation window and from People Ops for overlap exception.

Preliminary recommendation: approve 7-day overlap conditional on recorded sign-off in ticket and on credential rotation schedule and logging enabled for both service accounts.
policy_clarification: Question for Security/People Ops: our default role-change overlap is 72 hours. For manager transitions where continuity of in-flight work is business-critical, is there an established escalation/use of 'short-term overlap exception' (formal approval cadence)? If not, can we provision a documented one-off exception for Rahul with People Ops + Security co-approval? Please confirm required approvers and any audit trail requirements.

2026-03-10 13:05 - Security (via comment): We need to rotate credentials for svc-ci-deploy and svc-data-sync before any ownership transfer. Please provide last-used audits and a proposed rotation window where CI deploys will have a fallback user to avoid deploy disruption.

2026-03-11 09:40 - People Ops (Nora Simmons): Support the 7-day overlap pending manager confirmation. We require Rahul's acceptance of the manager role and acknowledgment of device return policy by 2026-03-14.

2026-03-12 15:12 - Marco Chen: Booked device collection tentative slot 2026-03-30 10:00 PT with Facilities (subject to final confirmation). Also scheduled credential rotation for svc-* accounts: 2026-03-15 02:00 UTC with rollback plan.

2026-03-13 10:48 - Rahul Mehta (comment): Confirming acceptance of manager role and OK with 7-day overlap and rotation schedule. Will document active in-flight PRs and any scheduled deploys in this ticket today.
resolution_notes: Pending: awaiting Security and People Ops approvals for 7-day overlap exception and execution of credential rotation. Post-rotation validation and asset re-image outcomes will be recorded here. Final closure steps: confirm SCIM group changes, post-rotation deploy smoke tests pass, asset re-image succeeded, Confluence runbook updated, and notify Billing/Facilities.
